models.notes: Track B generic auto-rig. CUDA-only: the dependency stack imports flash_attn/spconv unconditionally, so macOS is excluded honestly. Adapter lands P3-T3; the entry exists so install/verify/gates are real from day one.

versions.notes: MEASURED, and the number depends on a CONFIG choice (sidecar-vram: config is part of the VRAM contract). Our adapter runs the NON-FLASH attention path because flash-attn 2.8.3 varlen silently produces all-NaN skin weights on Windows sm_86 (P0-T4), so the floor is that path: 17.4 GiB at the 50k-face decimation cap our adapter uses. The 10.0 GiB figure sometimes quoted is the FLASH path we deliberately do not use - gating on it would let a 12 GiB card pass and then OOM. P3-T3 live run on the 8.5k-vertex humanoid measured a 15.07 GiB global peak (nvidia-smi memory.used, 123 samples, RTX 3090) and 69s wall end-to-end: extract 6.1s, skeleton 29.6s, skin 26.3s, merge 0.8s. URLs pinned to HF revision 36842e2b - staged releases are why hashes pin exact.

models.notes: PREREQUISITE THAT CANNOT BE AUTO-INSTALLED: the image conditioner facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m is a MANUALLY GATED repo - a human must request access from Meta and supply an HF token. Its licence permits commercial use and redistribution but requires displaying 'Built with DINOv3'. Deliberately NOT depended on: pipeline.json also names briaai/RMBG-2.0, which is gated and non-commercially licensed; SpriteBook passes an image that already carries alpha, and preprocess_image() skips rembg entirely when has_alpha is true, so BiRefNet is never constructed. SPIKE 2026-07-27 (spikes/trellis2/REPORT.md) SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-19 D-028 verdict: it IS installable under the wheels-only law on Windows. Five prebuilt CUDA extension wheels (cumesh, flex_gemm, nvdiffrast, nvdiffrec_render, o_voxel) install with zero compilation; ATTN_BACKEND=xformers is REQUIRED because sparse attention has no SDPA fallback and flash-attn needs a compiler. Measured on an RTX 3090: peak 9.26 GiB reserved, ~65-140 s per character after an ~82 s one-time load. KNOWN LIMIT - THE TEXTURE STAGE COLLAPSES ON ~5% OF SEEDS for character art. Measured over 40 runs (4 subjects x 10 seeds at 512): 2 unusable, both at seed 42, one of them a hard collapse where the decoder emits a constant at the bottom of its range. Healthy base_color means span 0.147-0.723 including a deliberately dark subject at 0.18; the failures sat at 0.0415 and 0.0006. DETECT WITH THE MEAN, NOT THE MAX: one failure had max 0.9856 from a few stray texels, so a max-based check passes an unusable character. mean < 0.10 sits in an empty valley between the two populations. An adapter retries on the next seed; 2 retries take residual failure to ~0.01%, so the texture substage is an optional upgrade rather than a rescue. Also: 512 textures more reliably than 1024_cascade (0.41-0.45 vs 0.10-0.31), and a MIXED shape-1024/texture-512 run is viable and scored best of the three on both seeds tried (n=2, unconfirmed).

versions.notes: All 22 repo files are pinned because pipeline.json sets default_pipeline_type=1024_cascade - a 512-only subset cannot run the shipped default. Hashes are upstream LFS oids (independently confirmed: the locally cached TRELLIS-image-large decoder blob hashes exactly to its declared pin); the small plain configs were fetched and hashed locally at pin time 2026-07-19. deps/trellis-image-large/ carries the cross-repo sparse-structure decoder that pipeline.json names (MIT, ungated). minVramGb stays ABSENT because the sidecar-vram law takes MEASURED peaks only and nothing has been measured: upstream STATES >=24 GiB (verified on A100/H100), which is recorded here as an upstream claim, not a measurement.

lowVram.description: load each model for its stage and offload after. TRUE is the shipped default and the reason peak VRAM is ~9 GiB rather than the ~24 the README quotes for the all-resident case.

pipelineType.description: 1024_cascade is the shipped default and needs both tiers

models.notes: A SYNTHETIC backend, not an AI model: it derives a seed-deterministic textured mesh from the source silhouette. It exists so the whole gen->border->receipt->pick path can be run, tested and demoed on any machine with no GPU, no weights and no download - the role echo plays for the job protocol. Use a real gen3d backend for actual characters.

versions.notes: Weightless: installing it writes only a receipt. Deterministic - the same image and seed reproduce byte-identical output.
